scope: Narrow independent static adaptation and field-interface review. Local source/JSON/AST/byte hashing only; no collector, sealer, trace parser, original auditor, binder, runtime, Cargo, workload or host was executed.

runtime_interfaces.why_dynamic: Actual parent/adapter include future ACTUAL/SPEC injection; full prerequisites and campaign inputs depend on real qualification, CI and ordinary closure. Their original bytes must exist and be pinned at collection time rather than predicted in this template.
runtime_interfaces.installed_inventory: The new runtime_binding matches the reviewed installer schema, target, installed/non-execution flags, absolute files array, file_count and payload_bytes. Fifteen static members plus four runtime members form exactly the nineteen original Linux installation members.
runtime_interfaces.original_intent: Campaign input schema/attempt/launcher SHA and prerequisites/binder/adapter identities match the reviewed parent sealer. The original foundation's canonical module path/bytes/SHA equals the copied fixed binder bytes; no binder is executed.
runtime_interfaces.positive_result_fields: The already-reviewed parent and corrected adapter produce the exact 468 ON request-bijection, 384 ON measured-request and inclusive CPU of validation_worker and validation_owner fields checked here. These values are original fixed protocol completeness conditions, not predicted results or new performance thresholds.
runtime_interfaces.source_snapshots: D2 and original D1 each have 222 entries, same keys and exactly the two reviewed diagnostic source differences. The remaining D1 root string is the correct historical baseline-source path.

safety_and_preservation.create_archive_and_verify_delta: Only current D2 archive schema strings; bounded IO, source stamping, exclusions, deterministic tar, O_EXCL/fsync writes and zero filesystem extraction are unchanged.
safety_and_preservation.native: Original holder terminal and 1..16 contiguous raw read pages are mandatory; original raw bytes and EOF accounting retained without synthetic pages.
safety_and_preservation.raw_captures: Original report/stage streams, controller transport/index/resource evidence, eight fixed trace paths when complete, original monitor reports and copied Mac holder logs retain their original byte identities.
safety_and_preservation.failed_or_partial: Original nullable core receipts, errors, nonzero statuses, incomplete stages and trace inventories remain captured. Reconciliation errors are reported as receipt_binding_errors. The archive never relabels the original parent/adapter/holder result as successful.
safety_and_preservation.success_capture: Only actual original success triggers complete two-stage/eight-close/936-call/468-bijection/384-measured evidence checks. A successful holder whose local original mirror is incomplete cannot be silently sealed as a failed run.
safety_and_preservation.sealer: Eleven original pure helpers retained verbatim. Only original receipt selection/namespace and actual_from_originals change; source output is AST literal ACTUAL substitution, not target import/execution.
safety_and_preservation.cost_scope: No trace reparse, arithmetic recomputation, auditor rerun, original monitor validator rerun or ELF-body rehash. Parent-inclusive whole validation cost remains distinguished from newly smaller exclusive residual.
safety_and_preservation.external_prerequisites: Prior Q/CI/ordinary archive bodies are not copied or revalidated by this collector. Their declaration is explicitly external; no future archive SHA is invented.

limitations: Both reviewed source artifacts are unsealed. This review does not claim that D2 C1 has run or that any diagnostic or optimization result passed.
Successful byte preservation/zero-extraction verification is distinct from the original workflow outcome and from receipt reconciliation.
Actual seal-time injection and future raw originals remain subject to their original byte checks; no new execution gate was added by this review.
